step_matches.reason: Both have the requestor log in to the NTRR website and open Request a New Account.
Both download the Data Access Request template.
Both complete and sign the DAR; the AI version only adds detail.
Both fill in the required account fields.
Both have Operations staff review the DAR for accuracy and completeness.
Both have Operations staff contact the applicant for more information.
Both have Operations staff provide the DAR to the DAC.
Both have the DAC review the information and authorize data access.
Both have the Admin establish the user account with matching privileges.
Both have the Admin send the automated activation email.
Both have the requestor check the inbox for the approval email.
Both have the requestor check spam and/or contact the NTRR team.
Both have the requestor return to the website and log in.
Both have the requestor access NTRR data.

decision_matches.reason: Both ask whether the DAR has errors, with Yes leading to contacting the applicant and No leading to providing the DAR to the DAC.
Both ask whether the approval email arrived in a timely manner, with Yes leading to logging in and No leading to checking spam or contacting the team.
